'''Mi'no Teest'''<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]]<ref name="SWc" /> who was present in [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] on [[Takodana]] when the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] the [[planet]].<ref name="VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MinoTeest.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Daran Holliman's character.]]
Mi'no Teest first appeared in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars:'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], where he was portrayed by an unidentified extra.<ref name="VII" /> His name was first revealed in the video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''.<ref name="LEGO" /> Although the game itself is non-[[canon]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]] has confirmed that the names given to previously unnamed background characters are.<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|nobackup=1}}</ref> While Teest can not be found in the film,<ref name="VII" /> an individual portrayed by Daran Holliman<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=paul.robinson.18400|url=photo.php?fbid=10153302513641707|name=Paul Robinson|date=2016-04-02|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/yEkrg}}</ref> also carries a black helmet<ref name="SWc" /> and can be spotted within and outside of the castle.<ref name="VII" />
